verdicts.reason: Both lose the can artwork: its body is orange-on-orange and shows only as a faint outline, and the cream badge circle is cut off in the bottom-left corner. Both also have a headline far too small for a story-format canvas, tiny subcopy, and large dead orange areas. A is worse because its NEW pill sits below the Try It CTA, out of reading order and stranded near the corner circle, and because a large empty band above the headline pushes the text down. B at least keeps NEW above the CTA, close to the product, and anchors the headline nearer the top.
